tagline: Stone temples on extinct volcanoes, plus the home of Thai football and big-league motorsport
introHtml: Buriram is a lower-Isan province that has reinvented itself in recent years, going from a quiet town to a sports city with both the Chang Arena football stadium and the Chang International Circuit, which hosts major races every year. At the same time the old side is still very much intact. Phanom Rung sits proudly on the crater of an extinct volcano and is one of the most beautiful Khmer temples in Thailand. Nearby you'll also find Prasat Muang Tam, more old volcanoes, and bold Isan food to try around the smaller towns. Buriram works for football fans, motor fans, and history buffs all in one trip.
bestTime: November–February, cool and comfortable, ideal for walking the temples and being outdoors. In early April the sun aligns to shine straight through the doorways at Phanom Rung.

highlights.name: Phanom Rung
highlights.blurb: A Khmer stone temple atop Phanom Rung hill, the crater of an old volcano. The approach walkway and the temple itself are stunning, and it's the symbol of the province.

highlights.name: Chang Arena
highlights.blurb: Home ground of Buriram United. Match days are electric, with the whole town turning out in the club's Thunder Castle shirts to cheer.

highlights.name: Chang International Circuit
highlights.blurb: A proper international racetrack that holds major races every year. When there's an event on, the town fills up with fans.

highlights.name: Prasat Muang Tam
highlights.blurb: A Khmer temple not far from Phanom Rung, ringed by L-shaped ponds and naga balustrades. An easy stroll to pair with Phanom Rung.

highlights.name: Khao Kradong
highlights.blurb: An old volcano in the middle of town topped by a large Phra Suphat Bophit Buddha. Climb the naga staircase for views over the whole city.

highlights.name: Plearn Wan (Plern Plearn)
highlights.blurb: A large learning center and flower garden near Nang Rong district, with seasonal flower zones and enough activities to fill a day.

foodScene.name: Isan food
foodScene.note: Som tam, larb, koi, grilled chicken — bold, true Isan flavors you'll find in every district.

foodScene.name: Goong jom
foodScene.note: A specialty from Prakhon Chai district: fermented tiny shrimp with a sour-salty kick, eaten with fresh vegetables and pork belly.

foodScene.name: Khao mao
foodScene.note: Young rice pounded and tossed with coconut and sugar, a local snack found at markets and souvenir stalls.

foodScene.name: Sen Chan pad pu & noodles
foodScene.note: The town has several long-running noodle and stir-fried-noodle shops with friendly prices.

foodScene.name: Mu kratha
foodScene.note: DIY grill-and-hotpot joints are everywhere in town, a favorite dinner for Buriram locals, especially on match days.

foodScene.name: Cafes and coffee
foodScene.note: Plenty of new cafes have opened in town and around Chang Arena — a good spot to sip a coffee before heading out again.

foodScene.name: Evening market street food
foodScene.note: The night markets and walking streets in town serve grilled and fried snacks and sweets to graze on after dark.

foodScene.name: Khanom jeen Prakhon Chai
foodScene.note: Rice noodles with curry sauce and lower-Isan chili dip, soft strands piled with plenty of fresh vegetables.

attractions.name: Phanom Rung Historical Park
attractions.blurb: A sandstone temple on the crater of an old volcano, with a naga walkway and gorgeous carved details. The province's signature photo spot.

attractions.name: Prasat Muang Tam
attractions.blurb: A lowland Khmer temple ringed by ponds and naga, close enough to Phanom Rung to visit both in a day.

attractions.name: Chang Arena
attractions.blurb: Buriram United's football stadium. Match days buzz, and the area around it has restaurants and team merchandise.

attractions.name: Chang International Circuit
attractions.blurb: A large racetrack next to the football stadium, with motorsport events and activities throughout the year.

attractions.name: Khao Kradong Forest Park
attractions.blurb: An extinct volcano in the heart of the city. Climb the naga staircase to pay respects at Phra Suphat Bophit and see the crater.

attractions.name: Plearn Wan
attractions.blurb: A large flower garden and learning center near Nang Rong, with seasonal flower zones and a restaurant in the grounds.

attractions.name: Huai Chorakhe Mak Reservoir
attractions.blurb: A wetland near town, good for birdwatching and morning shots of red lotus, with a quiet, peaceful feel.

attractions.name: Wat Khao Angkhan
attractions.blurb: A temple on an old volcano in the Chaloem Phra Kiat area, with an ornately decorated hall and viewpoints over the open plains.
